summary: Encouraged by last night election results. It's not a blue wave but more tide. 30,000 margin in FL and a 200,000 in TX. Demographic shifts may take care of the election. Margins easily made up by old white people dying and younger and more diverse voters coming of age
author: Greg McVerry
